title: Anthropic Enterprise organization key (sk-ant-api01-): must be flagged (provider-documented) [legacy tier T1]
summary: Synthetic Anthropic Enterprise organization key (sk-ant-api01-) values built to the documented format appear in 6 inputs in CI configuration, HTTP headers, prose, source code, structured files (JSON, YAML, TOML), and command and tool output. Each input records the exact byte range of the secret.
rationale: A credential that a scanner misses in an ordinary carrier is leaked. Carriers differ in quoting, delimiters and surrounding text, so a hit on one carrier does not show coverage of another.

expectation.rationale: Synthetic value matches the pinned lexical format contract. Provider issuance, payload/checksum validity and liveness are not claimed.
